name: Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park

bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed at standard shows. At table and cooler shows, average size bags are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" (standard shows)
Small clutches up to 6" x 9", not required to be clear (standard shows)
Average size bags or backpacks, subject to search (table and cooler shows only)
One cooler per person up to 23" long and 16" deep (table and cooler shows only)
Average size blankets or beach towels
Personal size umbrellas without sharp points
One factory sealed water bottle up to 1 liter (standard shows)
prohibited: GoPros, drones, professional cameras and iPads
bagPolicy.note: The venue runs two formats. Standard (non table) shows use the clear bag rule. Table and cooler shows allow average size bags and backpacks plus food, drinks and one cooler per person; liquor bottles must be 375 ml (one pint) or smaller. Check which format your show uses. Policy as posted on the venue's Live Nation operated site.

parking.note: There is limited metered street parking near the venue. Commercial lots are available on 5th and Bainbridge Streets, but they accept cash only. ParkWhiz offers additional parking options.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located outside the gates at the bottom of the hill on Elliott Galloway Way, next to Gate #1. The box office is open on event days, two hours prior to show time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
